We need to produce a correct tool call. The previous attempts may have had line breaks inside tags causing parsing errors. Ensure tags are on separate lines but no extra spaces before opening tags. Let's craft:

<thought>We need to search the template catalog for templates that involve breaking a halide functional group. This will return many candidates, from which we can identify the Friedel‑Crafts acylation template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles":"COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CCl)cc3)c2N)c1","functional_groups_broken":["halide"],"limit":100}</action_input>

Make sure JSON keys are strings. That should be accepted.
